invariants.rationale: The method always returns an Iterator, either from JavaLazyInsertIterable or from the superclass, neither of which are expected to be null.
idPfx is passed as a parameter and is likely required for the underlying file handling; such prefixes are typically not null.
recordItr is a required source Iterator for hoodie records; returning an Iterator over results would not make sense without it.
The returned value result must always be an Iterator (of List<WriteStatus>) by method contract.
Both recordItr and idPfx are needed for successful result construction, regardless of branch taken.
